g.text: TIER 1 — edge controller (per floor, per room, every 5 s)
TIER 2 — server agent (per alert, 3 in parallel)

text.tspan: FIRE — release every door on this floor
same room + severity within 60 s → drop
release doors on the other floors (once per incident)
evacuation routes · viewer effects + red card
(edge re-locks if floor clear and it owns the release)
